# Toast

Toast for a thread that finished while you were elsewhere.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.Toast` · 07 Components

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.Toast title={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.Toast" title="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Toast (Bencho "bell", web/src Toaster.tsx): 44px+, 22px radius, elev surface + menu shadow, springs in (460ms spring). Used when a running thread finishes while you're elsewhere. Stack bottom-right, max 4.
